description.value: Municipal RV park on the banks of the Coldwater River in Merritt, open April through October with full hookups and heated showers; cyclists can use the single non-serviced site at $33/night, with a five-minute walk to downtown restaurants and shops.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and confirms Claybanks RV Park is an active municipal campground. The website explicitly mentions heated showers, water hookups, a sanidump, and food/restaurants within a 5-minute walk of downtown Merritt; online reservations are confirmed via LetsCamp.ca. A minor address discrepancy exists: OSM records 1300 Voght Street while the website consistently states 1302 Voght Street across multiple pages, so the website value is used.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM records '1300 Voght Street' but the website consistently lists '1302 Voght Street' across multiple pages including the contact footer and map subpage. Website value used; OSM may need correction.
WiFi is explicitly unavailable: website states 'NOTE: WiFi is currently not yet available.'
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, operational municipal campground with heated showers, water, and walking-distance food resupply — a useful and well-documented overnight stop for touring cyclists transiting through Merritt.
enrichment_extras.notes: Municipal campground owned and operated by the Corporation of the City of Merritt. Reservations are managed through LetsCamp.ca. A golf discount partnership with Nicola Valley – Merritt Golf & Country Club is offered to guests.
